comparison.objective: Clamp and orient a chip carrier under a spring clip, not recover media.
comparison.physical_skill: Spring-tab actuation with planar alignment and insertion versus screen agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Carrier flat, centered, oriented, clamped, and released; no passed/retained material groups.
comparison.reason: Spring-clamp loading differs materially from granular separation. Earlier versions omit pin-1 orientation, but the latest rubric is explicit.
